items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, Rafferty Nwosu here from the debate society. Normally all of us practise together on Thursdays at 7 p.m. in Room 365 of Pemberly House. With the regional tournament next weekend, this week will be different. New members, your session moves to Tuesday, still at 7 p.m., and you'll be in Room 451. We usually save impromptu rounds, where you get the motion as you walk in, until the spring term, because they're tough. But several of you are already better than I was. So on Tuesday we'll try three impromptu rounds, and I'll judge them myself. The tournament squad keeps Thursday in Room 365, but please arrive at 6:30 p.m. so we can fit in a full mock round before the building closes. If you can't attend your own session, email me rather than joining the other one.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Debate society] When is the next practice session for new members?
items.explanation: The speaker tells new members, "your session moves to Tuesday, still at 7 p.m." "Thursday at 7 p.m." is the usual joint practice that changes this week. "Thursday at 6:30 p.m." is the time given to the tournament squad ("keeps Thursday ... please arrive at 6:30 p.m."), not to new members. "Tuesday at 6:30 p.m." attaches the squad's earlier start to the new members' day; the new-member time stays at 7 p.m.
